bullets.text: Under supervision within a student team, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, ranked public policy excerpts for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling for the public policy excerpts.
Under supervision within a student team, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, used TF-IDF features and a logistic-regression text classifier for public research abstracts, evaluating a fixed held-out split using macro F-score and example errors.
Under supervision, joined research abstract identifiers to bibliographic metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
Within a supervised research team, implemented reusable Python modules for the programming-question workflow and wrote regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs using pytest.

Under supervision, compared a TF-IDF classifier with a majority-label reference on held-out programming-question groups; checked near-duplicate overlap and examined label-specific errors across repeated splits.
Under supervision, joined programming-question document identifiers to post metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
